faqs.answer: No. Friend listens and chats over text but does not connect to email, calendar, or tasks. GAIA does the doing across 50+ tools.
faqs.question: Does Friend do any real work?

faqs.answer: The Friend pendant costs $249 plus your time doing everything yourself. GAIA has a free tier, and Pro is a flat ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month.
faqs.question: What does switching from Friend save me?

faqs.answer: GAIA reads your email, manages your calendar, and creates tasks. It turns the context Friend only chats about into completed work.
faqs.question: What do I gain by switching to GAIA?

metaDescription: Want more than a $249 companion? GAIA is the open-source Friend alternative that clears inbox, calendar, and tasks for you.
metaTitle: Best Friend Alternative: Assistant That Acts
migrationSteps: Keep Friend for company if you like it; GAIA replaces the workload
Connect Gmail and Calendar so GAIA sees what Friend only hears about
Tell GAIA your weekly routines once so it can run them
Check the first morning briefing, then let it run
name: Friend
painPoints: $249 buys companionship, not capability: nothing gets done
No email, calendar, or task connections at all
Closed hardware and software with no self-hosted path
Always-on microphone owned by someone else's cloud
Context stays in chat instead of becoming completed work
tagline: Keep the company. Add the capability.
whyPeopleLook: Friend is honest about what it is: company. The disappointment arrives around week three, when users realize the pendant knows about their busy day and does nothing about it. People searching for a Friend alternative want the same always-there feeling attached to real follow-through: an assistant that hears about the dentist appointment and books it.
